rationale: LIVE in 2024_general and 2026_primary (two of three elections, check 1), LATER in 2026_runoff because precinct values were protected on election night. Two elections share LIVE, so LIVE_PRECINCT; settled by check 1, so high.

comparison_notes.2024_general: same (LIVE, check 1). Both read election-day precinct votes first at 9:51 PM CST in v352313 and five night updates with election-day votes. Research precinct_first_seen 19:19 CT is the early and mail only update; consistent with its own note.

comparison_notes.2026_runoff: same (LATER, check 1).
